notes: Condo buildings first. Scout scans high volume; only RESEARCH listings that pass yield screen. Underwriting target remains target_cap_rate after expenses.

asset_focus.rationale: Multi-unit condo buildings offer repeatable comps, known HOA, and cluster opportunities; SFH/townhouse are secondary.

markets.name: Tampa, FL
markets.rationale: Strong rental demand, no state income tax, diverse economy

markets.name: Jacksonville, FL
markets.rationale: Affordable price points, growing population, military presence

markets.name: Birmingham, AL
markets.rationale: Low entry prices, potential for higher yields

markets.name: Memphis, TN
markets.rationale: Strong rental market, affordable prices, no state income tax

markets.name: Cleveland, OH
markets.rationale: Low prices relative to rent, diverse employment base

scout_instructions.screening_threshold: Rough gross yield must be >= target_yield_minimum (10%) to pass to RESEARCH. Reject below 10%.

strategy: Filter each market for Condo / Condominium only before SFH or townhouse.
Search by building name or street address when a condo complex has multiple active listings.
When one unit in a building passes yield screen, review other units in the same building.
Prefer established condo buildings (20+ units) with published HOA fees on the listing.
Record building_name and unit in meta.json when available.
building_signals: Multiple units for sale in same building
Lower price per sqft vs neighborhood SFH

hoa_screening.quick_adjusted_yield: For condos with stated HOA, also compute (monthly_rent - hoa_monthly) * 12 / price; flag if below 8% even when gross yield passes.

flags: Known special assessments are a yellow flag
STR restrictions may limit upside but do not disqualify for LTR strategy

rescreen_triggers: Price decrease of 5% or more vs screening_snapshot
Listing relisted after inactive or pending status change
HOA or special assessment change noted on listing
